metadata.description: Local marketplace for the pipeline-first renmark build assistant.

plugins.name: renmark
plugins.description: Pipeline-first build assistant for Codex and Claude Code. Seven pipelines — /renmark:init (adopt a repo), /renmark:start (new build), /renmark:rethink (reassess/transform an existing app), /renmark:feature (add/change), /renmark:debug (fix), /renmark:roadmap (gaps / what's next), /renmark:finish (ship) — plus guided planning, implementation, verification, recovery, and release skills. Persistent project state lives in .renmark/.
